correctness.rationale: The 15-cell integer profile reduction is a complete classification of four distinct queried triples; 666 valid profiles. Each center has at most three outside points, so a four-case exact trace enumeration is universally sufficient. Exact multinomial placement weights divided by 24 give all 15 buckets. The supplied Python source replayed the exhaustive count and a structurally independent C++ direct enumeration agrees at n=9; a separate proof derives the unique first-onset orbit. Finite experiments alone are not used to assert the infinite statement.
